## tmh learners export

Export learners

### Synopsis

Exports the organization's learners in one course as CSV, optionally only those with one `status`. Requires the `learners:read` scope.

--wait polls the Operation until it is done (up to --wait-timeout) and prints it; if it failed, tmh prints its problem and exits as its HTTP status would, or 7 without one. -o <file> saves the finished export's CSV instead.

Scopes: learners:read

```
tmh learners export [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --course-id string        The course to export. Defaults to the organization's default course.
  -d, --data stringArray        body field as key=value (dotted keys nest, key[]=v appends, key:=<json> sends JSON), or the whole body as @file, @- for stdin, or a JSON document; repeatable. Flags override -d fields, which override the document
      --format csv              The file format. Only csv today; one of: csv (required)
  -h, --help                    help for export
  -o, --output string           save the export's CSV to this file, or - for stdout, once it is done (implies --wait)
      --status string           Only export learners with this status; one of: not_started, invite_bounced, in_progress, compliant, expiring_soon, expired, removed
      --wait                    wait until the Operation is done and print it; a failed Operation exits as its HTTP status would
      --wait-timeout duration   how long --wait waits before giving up (default 5m0s)
```
